qualifiers.snap: played ≥ 25% of his team's offensive/defensive snaps through the data week
qualifiers.pass: ≥ 14 pass attempts per team game (PFR standard)
qualifiers.cov: ≥ 2 coverage targets per team game and ≥ 25% def. snaps
qualifiers.espn: ESPN's published top-N list for that position (rank shown is ESPN's)
